cases.name: recon-chain
cases.prompt: Find out who the registrar for example.com is, then scan 127.0.0.1 for open ports. Report both findings.

cases.name: chain-with-dependency
cases.prompt: Scan 127.0.0.1 for open ports. If you find a web server, run nikto against http://127.0.0.1 as well. Summarise what you found.

cases.name: pivot-on-failure
cases.prompt: Run a WHOIS lookup for example.com and tell me the registrar. If the lookup cannot run, say plainly what you could not determine rather than guessing.

cases.name: no-tool-control
cases.prompt: In one sentence, what does the acronym WHOIS refer to? Do not run any tools.
